mapper.select: WITH -- 目标设备：只取顶级支路（parent_id IS NULL）下的设备 target_devices AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bd.device_id FROM bbx_branch_device bd INNER JOIN bbx_energy_branch b ON bd.branch_id = b.id AND b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} WHERE b.parent_id IS NULL ), -- 1. 获取每个设备在指定年份内的所有抄表记录（取每天最后一条） daily_last AS ( SELECT device_id, TRUNC(count_time) AS record_date, reading_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id, TRUNC(count_time) ORDER BY count_time DESC) AS rn FROM bbx_meter_person_record_count WHERE count_time >= TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND count_time < TO_DATE(#{year}+1 || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM target_devices) AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} ), -- 2. 每个设备每月最后一条记录 month_last AS ( SELECT device_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM record_date) AS yr, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM record_date) AS mon, reading_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM record_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM record_date) ORDER BY record_date DESC) AS rn FROM daily_last WHERE rn = 1 ), -- 3. 获取每个设备在年初之前（上一年12月31日之前）的最后一条记录 before_year_last AS ( SELECT device_id, reading_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY count_time DESC) AS rn FROM bbx_meter_person_record_count WHERE count_time < TO_DATE(#{year} || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM target_devices) AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} ), -- 4. 关联上月月末值（用于计算1月能耗） month_with_prev AS ( SELECT m.device_id, m.yr, m.mon, m.reading_value, LAG(m.reading_value) OVER (PARTITION BY m.device_id ORDER BY m.mon) AS prev_reading, -- 对于1月，使用年初之前的最后一条记录作为 prev CASE WHEN m.mon = 1 THEN b.reading_value ELSE NULL END AS year_start_reading FROM month_last m LEFT JOIN before_year_last b ON m.device_id = b.device_id AND b.rn = 1 WHERE m.rn = 1 ), -- 5. 计算每个设备每月能耗 device_month_energy AS ( SELECT device_id, yr, mon, reading_value - COALESCE(prev_reading, year_start_reading, reading_value) AS energy FROM month_with_prev ), -- 6. 按月汇总 month_energy_total AS ( SELECT mon, SUM(COALESCE(energy, 0)) AS total_energy FROM device_month_energy GROUP BY mon ), -- 7. 生成1~12月序列 months AS (SELECT LEVEL AS mon FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12) SELECT m.mon AS date, COALESCE(e.total_energy, 0) AS personElectricity FROM months m LEFT JOIN month_energy_total e ON m.mon = e.mon ORDER BY m.mon

WITH -- 目标设备：只取顶级支路（parent_id IS NULL）下的设备 target_devices AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bd.device_id FROM bbx_branch_device bd INNER JOIN bbx_energy_branch b ON bd.branch_id = b.id AND b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} WHERE b.parent_id IS NULL ), -- 1. 获取指定月份内所有设备的抄表记录（取每天最后一条） daily_last AS ( SELECT device_id, TRUNC(count_time) AS record_date, reading_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id, TRUNC(count_time) ORDER BY count_time DESC) AS rn FROM bbx_meter_person_record_count WHERE count_time >= TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND count_time < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM target_devices) AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} ), -- 2. 获取每个设备在当月第一天之前的最后一条记录 before_month_last AS ( SELECT device_id, reading_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY count_time DESC) AS rn FROM bbx_meter_person_record_count WHERE count_time < TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM target_devices) AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} ), -- 3. 计算每日能耗（当日读数 - 前一日读数，第一天使用月初之前的读数作为基准） daily_with_prev AS ( SELECT d.device_id, d.record_date, d.reading_value, LAG(d.reading_value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.device_id ORDER BY d.record_date) AS prev_reading, -- 第一天的基准值 CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.device_id ORDER BY d.record_date) = 1 THEN b.reading_value ELSE NULL END AS month_start_reading FROM daily_last d LEFT JOIN before_month_last b ON d.device_id = b.device_id AND b.rn = 1 WHERE d.rn = 1 ), -- 4. 计算每个设备每日能耗 device_daily_energy AS ( SELECT device_id, record_date, reading_value - COALESCE(prev_reading, month_start_reading, reading_value) AS energy FROM daily_with_prev ), -- 5. 按日汇总 daily_energy_total AS ( SELECT record_date, SUM(COALESCE(energy, 0)) AS total_energy FROM device_daily_energy GROUP BY record_date ), -- 6. 生成当月所有日期序列（从1号到月末） days AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') + LEVEL - 1 AS day_date FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) ) SELECT d.day_date AS date, COALESCE(e.total_energy, 0) AS personElectricity FROM days d LEFT JOIN daily_energy_total e ON d.day_date = e.record_date ORDER BY d.day_date
